props.name: title
props.comment:
The title to display, translated via the i18n provider (with the string
itself as the fallback). For a custom title node, use the default slot
instead — the Vue idiom replacing the React twin's `title={<element>}`.

props.name: defaultTitle
props.comment: Fallback title used when `title` is undefined. Translated if present.

slots.name: default
slots.comment: A custom title node rendered verbatim (replaces the translated string).
